title: An investigation of bacteriocin nisin anti-cancer effects and FZD7 protein interactions in liver cancer cells.
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨乳酸链球菌素对肝癌细胞的抗癌作用及与FZD7蛋白的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白互作但非DNA互作体系，且方法仅为简单对接，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联微弱。
abstract: The bacteriocin, nisin, produced by Lactococcus and Streptococcus species during fermentation, is widely used for bio preservatives in a wide variety of foods. Liver cancer has a high mortality rate and is the fourth leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide. Recently, researchers have shown the anti-cancer effects of nisin through in vitro and in vivo studies. This study aimed to investigate the effect of nisin on liver cancer cell lines, which represented two subgroups of the disease model. Nisin exhibited significant growth inhibition and apoptosis in both cell lines, HuH-7, and SNU182. Drug resistance is the main problem in liver cancer and the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition has a role in the development of drug resistance in hepatocellular carcinoma. The expression of EMT transcription factors ZEB1, SNAI1, and TWIST1 were analyzed depending on nisin treatment, TWIST1 expression was down-regulated after nisin treatment compared to the untreated SNU182 and HuH-7 cell lines. Besides, due to the reported correlation between the overexpression of Frizzled (FZD) proteins, specifically FZD7, in primary hepatocellular carcinomas (HCCs), molecular docking was assessed for Nisin A in the binding site of FZD7. Results confirmed that Nisin A was able to form important hydrogen bonding with key residues. This research not only determined the role of nisin in different liver cancer cell models but it also provided the first result of FZD7 and nisin interaction.
abstract_zh: 乳酸菌和链球菌属在发酵过程中产生的细菌素——乳链菌肽（nisin），被广泛用作多种食品中的生物防腐剂。肝癌死亡率高，是全球癌症相关死亡的第四大原因。近期，研究人员通过体外和体内研究展示了乳链菌肽的抗癌效果。本研究旨在探讨乳链菌肽对肝癌细胞系的影响，这些细胞系代表了疾病模型的两个亚型。乳链菌肽在HuH-7和SNU182两种细胞系中均表现出显著的生长抑制和凋亡诱导作用。耐药性是肝癌的主要问题，而上皮-间质转化（epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition）在肝细胞癌耐药性发展中发挥作用。本研究分析了乳链菌肽处理后EMT转录因子ZEB1、SNAI1和TWIST1的表达情况，与未处理的SNU182和HuH-7细胞系相比，乳链菌肽处理后TWIST1表达下调。此外，鉴于已有报道指出Frizzled（FZD）蛋白（特别是FZD7）在原发性肝细胞癌（HCCs）中过表达，本研究对Nisin A在FZD7结合位点进行了分子对接评估。结果证实，Nisin A能够与关键残基形成重要氢键。这项研究不仅确定了乳链菌肽在不同肝癌细胞模型中的作用，还首次提供了FZD7与乳链菌肽相互作用的结果。
